#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a financial report PDF and prepend a cover page using raw PDF
syntax (pypdf available, but no reportlab) and pypdf for merging."""

import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W = 612   # US Letter width  (points)
PAGE_H = 792   # US Letter height (points)


def esc(text):
    """Escape parentheses and backslashes for a PDF literal string."""
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_op(x, y, size, text, font="/F1"):
    """Return PDF content operator drawing text with top-left origin (y from top)."""
    baseline = PAGE_H - y - size * 0.8
    return f"BT {font} {size} Tf {x} {baseline:.2f} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET"


def line_op(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    """Line drawing operator using top-left origin coordinates."""
    p1y = PAGE_H - y1
    p2y = PAGE_H - y2
    return f"{x1} {p1y:.2f} m {x2} {p2y:.2f} l S"


def rect_op(x, y, w, h):
    """Filled rectangle using top-left origin."""
    top = PAGE_H - y
    return f"{x} {top - h:.2f} {w} {h} re f"


def build_pdf(path, pages, meta=None):
    """Build a minimal PDF file with the given pages.

    pages: list of content-stream command strings (one per page).
    meta : optional dict of document metadata.
    """
    objects = []          # each entry: (obj_dict_text, stream_bytes_or_None)
    offsets = []          # byte offset of each object

    # ---- object 1: catalog ----
    objects.append(("<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>", None))

    # ---- object 2: pages root (kids filled later) ----
    objects.append(("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [] /Count 0 >>", None))

    # ---- object 3: shared Helvetica font ----
    objects.append(("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>", None))

    # ---- pages and their content streams ----
    page_objs = []
    content_objs = []
    for page_cmds in pages:
        stream = "\n".join(page_cmds).encode("latin-1")
        content_objs.append(stream)
        page_objs.append(None)  # placeholder, filled below

    # Reserve object numbers: font is object 3. Each page = page obj + content obj.
    next_obj = 4
    for i in range(len(pages)):
        page_num = next_obj
        content_num = next_obj + 1
        next_obj += 2
        page_objs[i] = page_num
        # page object
        page_dict = (
            "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %d %d] "
            "/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R >> >> /Contents %d 0 R >>"
            % (PAGE_W, PAGE_H, content_num)
        )
        objects.append((page_dict, None))
        # content stream object
        objects.append((None, content_objs[i]))

    # ---- update pages root with kids ----
    kids = " ".join(f"{n} 0 R" for n in page_objs)
    objects[1] = (f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {len(pages)} >>", None)

    # ---- metadata object (optional) ----
    meta_num = None
    if meta:
        meta_num = next_obj
        next_obj += 1
        info = []
        for k, v in meta.items():
            info.append(f"/{k} ({esc(str(v))})")
        objects.append(("<< " + " ".join(info) + " >>", None))

    # ---- trailer ----
    root_ref = "1 0 R"
    trailer = f"<< /Size {next_obj} /Root {root_ref}"
    if meta_num:
        trailer += f" /Info {meta_num} 0 R"
    trailer += " >>"

    # ---- assemble file with correct xref offsets ----
    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"
    offset = len(out)
    for i, (d, stream) in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(offset)
        out += f"{i + 1} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
        if d is not None:
            out += d.encode("latin-1") + b"\n"
        if stream is not None:
            out += b"stream\n" + stream + b"\nendstream\n"
        out += b"endobj\n"
        offset = len(out)

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {next_obj + 1}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += trailer.encode("latin-1") + b"\nstartxref\n"
    out += f"{xref_pos}\n".encode("latin-1") + b"%%EOF\n"

    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    print(f"pdf written: {path} ({len(pages)} page(s))")


def center_x(text, size, font_scale=0.5):
    """Approximate the width of text in points to center it."""
    # Helvetica average glyph width is about 0.5 * font size
    return (PAGE_W - len(text) * size * font_scale) / 2


def main():
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Build the report body (no cover yet): report_body.pdf
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    body_pages = []

    # Page 1: report header + overview
    p1 = [
        text_op(72, 72, 20, "ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT - FISCAL YEAR 2025"),
        line_op(72, 100, 540, 100),
        text_op(72, 130, 13, "This report summarizes the consolidated financial results of the company for"),
        text_op(72, 148, 13, "the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. All figures are in thousands of USD."),
        text_op(72, 192, 14, "1. Executive Summary"),
        text_op(72, 214, 12, "The company achieved record revenue of $12,450K, a year-over-year increase of"),
        text_op(72, 230, 12, "14.2%. Net income grew to $2,140K, driven by strong performance in the"),
        text_op(72, 246, 12, "enterprise segment and improved operating efficiency."),
        text_op(72, 290, 14, "2. Key Financial Highlights"),
        text_op(90, 312, 12, "- Total Revenue:            $12,450K  (+14.2% vs prior year)"),
        text_op(90, 330, 12, "- Gross Profit:             $7,830K   (62.9% margin)"),
        text_op(90, 348, 12, "- Operating Income:         $2,980K   (+11.8%)"),
        text_op(90, 366, 12, "- Net Income:               $2,140K   (+9.4%)"),
        text_op(90, 384, 12, "- Earnings per Share:       $2.14     (+9.2%)"),
        text_op(72, 428, 14, "3. Outlook"),
        text_op(72, 450, 12, "For fiscal year 2026, management expects continued revenue growth of 10-12%"),
        text_op(72, 466, 12, "with stable margins, supported by expansion into international markets."),
    ]
    body_pages.append(p1)

    # Page 2: quarterly table
    p2 = [
        text_op(72, 72, 16, "Quarterly Results (in thousands of USD)"),
        line_op(72, 100, 540, 100),
        # table header row
        rect_op(72, 120, 468, 24),
        text_op(90, 132, 11, "Quarter"),
        text_op(220, 132, 11, "Revenue"),
        text_op(320, 132, 11, "Expenses"),
        text_op(430, 132, 11, "Net Income"),
        # rows
        text_op(90, 158, 11, "Q1"),
        text_op(220, 158, 11, "2,890"),
        text_op(320, 158, 11, "1,120"),
        text_op(430, 158, 11, "490"),
        line_op(72, 176, 540, 176),
        text_op(90, 182, 11, "Q2"),
        text_op(220, 182, 11, "3,050"),
        text_op(320, 182, 11, "1,180"),
        text_op(430, 182, 11, "520"),
        line_op(72, 200, 540, 200),
        text_op(90, 206, 11, "Q3"),
        text_op(220, 206, 11, "3,140"),
        text_op(320, 206, 11, "1,210"),
        text_op(430, 206, 11, "545"),
        line_op(72, 224, 540, 224),
        text_op(90, 230, 11, "Q4"),
        text_op(220, 230, 11, "3,370"),
        text_op(320, 230, 11, "1,290"),
        text_op(430, 230, 11, "585"),
        line_op(72, 248, 540, 248),
        # total row
        rect_op(72, 256, 468, 24),
        text_op(90, 268, 11, "TOTAL"),
        text_op(220, 268, 11, "12,450"),
        text_op(320, 268, 11, "4,800"),
        text_op(430, 268, 11, "2,140"),
        text_op(72, 320, 14, "Notes to the Financial Statements"),
        text_op(72, 342, 12, "1. Revenue is recognized in accordance with ASC 606."),
        text_op(72, 360, 12, "2. Operating expenses include R&D, sales & marketing, and G&A."),
        text_op(72, 378, 12, "3. The company maintains no significant off-balance-sheet arrangements."),
        text_op(72, 430, 14, "Certification"),
        text_op(72, 452, 12, "The undersigned certify that the financial statements presented herein fairly"),
        text_op(72, 468, 12, "present, in all material respects, the financial condition of the company."),
        text_op(72, 520, 12, "_________________________________          ______________________________"),
        text_op(72, 538, 12, "Chief Executive Officer                    Chief Financial Officer"),
    ]
    body_pages.append(p2)

    body_meta = {
        "Title": "Annual Financial Report",
        "Subject": "Fiscal Year 2025 consolidated financial results",
        "Author": "Finance Department",
        "Creator": "PDF Skill (pypdf)",
    }
    build_pdf("report_body.pdf", body_pages, meta=body_meta)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2) Build the cover page: cover.pdf
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    subtitle = "Fiscal Year 2025"
    date_line = date_str

    cover = [
        # decorative rule near the top
        rect_op(72, 250, 468, 4),
        # title centered
        text_op(center_x(title, 34), 300, 34, title),
        # subtitle centered
        text_op(center_x(subtitle, 20), 360, 20, subtitle),
        # date centered
        text_op(center_x(date_line, 16), 420, 16, date_line),
        # decorative rule below
        rect_op(72, 470, 468, 4),
        # footer
        text_op(center_x("Finance Department", 12), 740, 12, "Finance Department"),
    ]
    cover_meta = {
        "Title": "Annual Financial Report",
        "Subject": "Cover page",
        "Author": "Finance Department",
        "Creator": "PDF Skill (pypdf)",
    }
    build_pdf("cover.pdf", [cover], meta=cover_meta)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3) Merge: cover.pdf + report_body.pdf -> report.pdf
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for src in ("cover.pdf", "report_body.pdf"):
        reader = PdfReader(src)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
    writer.add_metadata({
        "/Title": "Annual Financial Report",
        "/Subject": "Fiscal Year 2025 consolidated financial results with cover page",
        "/Author": "Finance Department",
        "/Creator": "PDF Skill (pypdf)",
    })
    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print("pdf merged: report.pdf created with cover page + body")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
